name: Emergent Divinity
body:
Your innate, godlike powers grow.

Prerequisite: Godling.

Benefit: You gain 1 rank of godling divine traits.

Special: This feat may be taken more than once. Each time it is selected, it gives you 1 additional divine trait rank. This feat may only be selected once per three character levels.
